select FBRI.BASE_RULE_TYPE baseRuleType, FBRI.PUBLISH_TYPE publishType, FBRI.RATE_LOWER*100 rateLower, FBRI.RATE_LIMIT*100 rateLimit, FBRI.BASE_RULE_ID baseRuleId, FBRI.EFF_DATE effDate, FBRI.RATE_TYPE rateType, FBRI.RATE*100 rate, FBRI.COEFFICIENT coefficient, FBRI.INDEX_ID indexId, FBRI.INDEX_SOURCE indexSource, FBRI.SPREAD_RATE*100 spreadRate, FBRI.RESET_TYPE resetType, FBRI.BASE_RULE_TYPE baseRuleType, FBRI.PUBLISH_TYPE publishType, FBRI.RATE_LOWER*100 rateLower, FBRI.RATE_LIMIT*100 rateLimit from FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO FBRI, FIN_PRODUCT FP, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPA where FBRI.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID AND FBRI.FINPROD_ID = FPA.FINPROD_ID
AND FBRI.BRANCH = 0
AND ((FBRI.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FPA.DEAL_MODE != #{dealMode10}) OR (FBRI.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FPA.DEAL_MODE = #{dealMode10} ))
AND FBRI.BASE_RULE_TYPE = #{baseRuleType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND FBRI.PUBLISH_TYPE = #{publishType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and FBRI.EFF_DATE = to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and (FBRI.EFF_DATE = FP.VDATE OR FP.FINPROD_TYPE2= #{finprodType2, jdbcType=VARCHAR})

select FBRI.BASE_RULE_TYPE baseRuleType, FBRI.PUBLISH_TYPE publishType, FBRI.RATE_LOWER*100 rateLower, FBRI.RATE_LIMIT*100 rateLimit, FBRI.BASE_RULE_ID baseRuleId, FBRI.EFF_DATE effDate, FBRI.RATE_TYPE rateType, FBRI.RATE*100 rate, FBRI.COEFFICIENT coefficient, FBRI.INDEX_ID indexId, FBRI.INDEX_SOURCE indexSource, FBRI.SPREAD_RATE*100 spreadRate, FBRI.RESET_TYPE resetType, FBRI.BASE_RULE_TYPE baseRuleType, FBRI.PUBLISH_TYPE publishType, FBRI.RATE_LOWER*100 rateLower, FBRI.RATE_LIMIT*100 rateLimit from FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO FBRI, FIN_PRODUCT FP, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPA where FBRI.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID AND FBRI.FINPROD_ID = FPA.FINPROD_ID
AND FBRI.BRANCH = 0
AND ((FBRI.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FPA.DEAL_MODE != #{dealMode10}) OR (FP.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FPA.DEAL_MODE = #{dealMode10} AND FPA.TERM_TYPE != #{termType02}))
AND FBRI.BASE_RULE_TYPE = #{baseRuleType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND FBRI.PUBLISH_TYPE = #{publishType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and FBRI.EFF_DATE = (select max(EFF_DATE) from FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO T1 WHERE T1.FINPROD_ID = FBRI.FINPROD_ID AND FBRI.BASE_RULE_TYPE = T1.BASE_RULE_TYPE AND T1.EFF_DATE >= to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') >= T1.EFF_DATE)
and (FBRI.EFF_DATE = FP.VDATE OR FP.FINPROD_TYPE2= #{finprodType2, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
